topic: How does the 14.6% bandwidth affect frequency planning for multi-satellite networks with adjacent channel interference risks?
consensus_response: The 14.6% bandwidth constraint increases adjacent channel interference risks, necessitating careful frequency planning using techniques like FDMA, dynamic allocation, and OFDMA. Inter-satellite synchronization and beamforming mitigate interference, while hybrid beamforming optimizes performance and complexity. Non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) further enhances capacity.
reference_context: SatCom systems operate on allocated frequencies, with Ku and Ka bands used for uplink and downlink transmissions, requiring efficient frequency planning to minimize interference.
